children.text: TrainZilla India - Transparent refund and cancellation policy
Last updated: January 15, 2025 | Compliant with Consumer Protection Act, 2019

At TrainZilla India, we are committed to providing exceptional service to fitness professionals across India. This Refund Policy outlines our fair and transparent approach to refunds and cancellations, designed in compliance with the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, and other applicable Indian laws.
This policy respects your rights as a consumer under Indian law, including the right to seek redressal for deficient services and unfair trade practices.
Complete access to all TrainZilla features for 14 days
No credit card required to start your trial
Full platform functionality including AI tools and client management
Dedicated onboarding support in Hindi and English
Cancel anytime during the trial with no charges
You can cancel your trial at any time by:
Visiting your account settings and clicking "Cancel Subscription"
Using our in-app live chat feature
We will not charge your payment method unless you explicitly choose to continue with a paid plan after your trial period ends.
Full refund if you cancel within 7 days of first payment
Not available for monthly plans after 7-day period
Refunds considered for documented service failures
Cancel anytime to prevent future billing
Full refund within 30 days of purchase
Available for remaining months after 30-day period
Refunds subject to fair usage policy
Enterprise customers have custom refund terms as specified in their service agreement. Enterprise refunds are handled on a case-by-case basis with dedicated account management.
Refunds may be denied for accounts showing excessive usage or apparent misuse of the refund policy.
Reach out to our support team via phone, email, or live chat
Share your account details and reason for refund request
Our team reviews your request within 24-48 hours
Approved refunds are processed within 7-14 business days
Account email address and registered phone number
Direct refund to your UPI ID
Instant notification via SMS and app
May take additional time to reflect in bank statement
Direct bank transfer to registered account
Refund to Paytm, PhonePe, or other wallets
For refunds involving GST, the entire amount including GST will be refunded. Updated GST credit notes will be issued within 7 days of refund processing for your tax records.
Third-party service fees (payment processing, SMS charges)
Training and certification programs after completion
Refunds may be denied in the following cases:
Account violations or misuse of platform
Excessive usage inconsistent with fair use
Requests made outside the specified time limits

In certain circumstances, we may offer partial refunds or service credits instead of full refunds. This may apply to accounts with extensive usage or when service issues affected only part of the billing period.
Your Consumer Rights Under Indian Law
As a consumer, you have the following rights under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019:
Right to be protected against unfair or restrictive trade practices
Right to be informed about quality, quantity, and standard of services
Right to seek redressal against deficient services
Right to consumer education and awareness
If you are not satisfied with our refund decision, you have the right to:
Escalate to our senior management team
File a complaint with the National Consumer Helpline (1915)
Approach the District Consumer Forum in your jurisdiction
Seek mediation through consumer dispute resolution mechanisms
We encourage resolving disputes through direct communication and are committed to fair resolution of all consumer grievances.
Our customer support team is here to help you with any refund-related questions or concerns.
This refund policy is compliant with Indian consumer protection laws and is subject to periodic updates to maintain compliance with changing regulations.
